verdict.rationale: mise has no built-in natural-language command interface. It does ship a first-party MCP server (`mise mcp`) through which an external AI assistant can read a project's tools, tasks, env vars and config, and run its tasks, so natural-language operation works only via a separate assistant and over a limited scope. missing for 10: native natural-language command mode, MCP coverage of operations like installing/switching tools or editing config, depth documentation of the MCP server, hands-on or independent corroboration of natural-language-driven use.
